newsitem.title: DENMARK: Superfos on watch list after Phoenix bid.
newsitem.headline: Superfos on watch list after Phoenix bid.

text.p: The Copenhagen Stock Exchange said on Thursday that it had placed construction and chemicals group Superfos on its watch list after its ground-breaking public offer for local roadmaker Phoenix Contractors.

Superfos earlier offered Phoenix shareholders 700 Danish crowns per share for their A-shares, and 620 crowns for C-shares, outbidding an earlier offer from Norway's Rieber and Son of 650 Danish crowns for the A-share and 585 for the C-share.
Analysts said that the Phoenix offers were the first time in Denmark that a takeover bid had been made publicly.

Traditionally, they said, offers were made discreetly, often through large institutional investors, and only announced when complete or if stakes acquired piecemeal exceeded statutory disclosure limits.
At 1115 GMT Superfos' share was up 15.53 crowns to 785.53, a rise of around two percent.
Phoenix was up a hefty 35 crowns, to 625 crowns, close to six percent above Wednesday's close.
